==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. The Cosmic Sea filled the sky above and it began to rain. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.) (The Cosmic Sea resembles a colorful ocean in space populated by giant fish and Were-Fish.)
It was Storm Rabbit making her move to permanently take over the village. (Storm Rabbit resembles a blue, humanoid, female rabbit dressed in regal, blue, Japanese robes decorated with shiny orange rose symbols.)
Fearing that the symbiotic algae would infest everything, I stopped her with a geomancy rock punch.
